records.notes: Editions compared (all PDFs opened from s7d2.scene7.com in this session). Performance is identical in DS100GS/611 (2011, C10550183), DS100PG/0113 (2013, C10550139; Spanish C10574540), DS100PG/1118 (2018) and DS100GS/0221 (2021, newest Mars 100 GS data sheet): 'Output Power 11 350 kWe', 'Heat Rate 10 935 kJ/kWe-hr (10,365 Btu/kWe-hr)', 'Exhaust Flow 153 245 kg/hr (337,850 lb/hr)' (DS100GS/0221 prints '153,245 kg/hr'), 'Exhaust Temp. 485°C (905°F)'. Same in BO&G/811 ('ISO Continuous 11 350 kWe'), BO&G/0819, BIL/512 and BIL/0622 (11 350 kWe, 32.9 %). Newest summary BPGPH/0525 (2025 Power Generation Product Handbook) prints rounded values in its 'PRODUCT LINE AND SPECIFICATIONS' table, Mars 100 column: ISO Output Power 11.3 MW, ISO Heat Rate 10,940 kJ/kWe-hr, Electrical Efficiency 32.9 %, Exhaust Gas Flow 42.6 kg/s (93.8 lb/s), Exhaust Gas Temp 484 °C (904 °F); Turbomach BPHBTBM/512 prints 11.35 MW, 10'934 kJ/kWE-hr, 32.92 %, 'Exhaust gas flow: kg/s 42.57', 484 C. Taken: 11 350 kWe, 10 935 kJ/kWe-hr, 153 245 kg/hr, 485 C from the data sheets (the 1 C / 5 kJ differences are rounding). exh_flow_kg_s 42.57 = 153 245/3600, also printed directly by Turbomach (42.57) and BPGPH/0525 (42.6). Efficiency: published 32.9 % (DS100GS/611 'Engine efficiency: 32.9%', BIL/0622, BPGPH/0525); DS100PG/0113 prints '32%', DS100PG/1118 and DS100GS/0221 print '33%'; 3600/10935 = 32.92 agrees with 32.9 - eff_pct is published, not computed. Pressure ratio differs by edition: DS100PG/1118 'Pressure Ratio: 17.8:1' (with inlet airflow 42.0 kg/s), DS100PG/0113 '17.7:1' (41.6 kg/s), DS100GS/611 '16.3:1' (41.6 kg/s; 16.3:1 is the Mars 90 value and contradicts every other Mars 100 sheet, treated as an editorial carry-over), MD/CS sheets of the same engine '17:1'. Taken 17.8 (newest sheet that prints PR). The former record note 'DS100PG/1118 gives ... 42.0 kg/s' refers to INLET airflow, not exhaust flow; exhaust flow stays 153 245 kg/hr. Turbine: GS sheets print only the power turbine - DS100PG/0113 and /1118 'Power Turbine - 2-Stage Reaction', DS100GS/611 '2-Stage, Axial'; the gas producer '2-Stage, Reaction - Max. Speed: 11,170 rpm' is from DS100MD/412 and DS100CS/412 (same engine). out_rpm = power-turbine (= main reduction drive input) speed 'Speed, 50-Hz Generator: 8625 rpm - Speed, 60-Hz Generator: 8570 rpm' (DS100GS/611, DS100PG/0113, DS100PG/1118); the record's former 8625 is kept as the 50 Hz value and 8570 rpm (60 Hz) added. Package: no Mars 100 GS turbomachinery package specification was found, so the newest GS data sheet DS100GS/0221 is used: 'Length: 14.2 m (46' 6") Width: 2.8 m (9' 2") Height: 3.8 m (12' 6") Package Weight, Approx: 82 145 kg (181,000 lb) Dry weight, unenclosed height, does not include ancillary equipment' (same in DS100PG/1118 and BIL/0622; BPGPH/0525 gives height 3.7 m (12' 1")). The former 86 180 kg is the 2011 'Typical Weight' of DS100GS/611 (basis not stated); see extra.pkg_alternatives. comp_stages/turb_stages/shafts/out_rpm are stored as text. Manufacturer product pages (https://www.solarturbines.com/en_US/products/power-generation-packages/mars-100.html ; https://solarturbines.com/en_US/products/mechanical-drive-packages/mars-100.html ; also tried https://www.solarturbines.com/en_US/products/mechanical-drive-packages/mars-100.html and .../gas-compressor-packages/mars-100.html) could not be opened: curl HTTP 403 Akamai 'Access Denied' at 18:23:34 UTC and again at 18:25:04 UTC 2026-11-14 (retry after >30 s); WebFetch: 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND www.solarturbines.com'. Their values are known only from search-index extracts (GS 11,350 kWe, 10,365 Btu/kWe-hr / 10,935 kJ, 337,850 lb/hr / 153,245 kg/hr, 905 F / 485 C; MD 15,900 hp / 11,860 kW, 7395 Btu/hp-hr / 10,465 kJ, 153,245 kg/hr, 485 C) and agree with the PDF data sheets used here; the PDFs are cited as the verifying source. Mars 90/100 CS/MD Turbomachinery Package Specification: only copy found is on pdf.directindustry.com (host outside the allowed list; an earlier step of this session recorded a proxy refusal for it and for the cloudfront copy) - not opened; www.manualsdir.com has no Mars TPS (Caterpillar brand pages list only the Taurus 70 TPS).
